scope: Bounded discovery of Greek official gazette and legislation routes; EU/EEA/Swiss and UK residence routes; visa and mission practice; civil status, foreign family evidence and limited adoption-related services; administrative procedure and public access; remedies/courts, oversight, privacy, legal aid and selected regional administration. This is not a legal-equivalence opinion or complete national inventory.
retrieval_status: 40 candidate pages converted; 0 PDFs preserved without text extraction; 0 discovery surfaces had no stable body; failures are recorded per item; no source accepted

comparison_seed.source: Danish EU-residence instrument and official guidance used as the comparison seed
comparison_seed.relationship_note: PD 106/2007 is a close functional source because the official Gazette identifies it as Greece’s implementation of Directive 2004/38 and its title covers EU citizen and family-member movement/residence. This does not establish legal equivalence. Greece’s EEA, Swiss, UK Withdrawal Agreement, national-family, visa and local administrative routes remain distinct.

previous_findings_carried_forward: No Greece pack or Greece row in the dated online-acquisition register was found in the current local inventory before this review; previous national candidates were therefore not treated as verified current sources.
Prior EU/EEA/Swiss country reviews contributed search leads and adapter lessons only. Their APIs, laws and retrieval patterns do not establish a Greek route.

Czechia’s keyless, date-bound PDF approach, Estonia’s XML route, Finland’s documented API and France’s public bulk data were carried forward only as comparison examples; none establishes Greek API terms, completeness or conversion behavior.
The earlier N-Lex review placed Greece on the N-Lex portal; this review treats it only as a discovery route and verifies candidate laws at Greek official channels.
